item.title: RT: A stock down 50% can still be expensive. The old high tells you where it’s been.
item.description:
A stock down 50% can still be expensive.

The old high tells you where it’s been. It tells you nothing about what it’s worth.

I don’t try to catch the exact bottom. I wait for expectations to get worse than the business.

My latest for @Barchart
